summary: The original consistency control uses primitive ValidMP and p = q, leaving compositional embedding open. Chicago/Michigan retrieval failures and the insufficient OUP preview were preserved, then a legitimate publisher-hosted 2022 Gibbard response was pinned, materialized and read. It distinguishes permitting from picking and denies full truth values to false-antecedent indicative conditionals. It therefore motivates permission-plan vocabulary but does not license attribution of the separately checked analyst material-support semantics to Gibbard. Exact routes, rejected identifications and remaining gaps are in docs/expressivist-embedding-boundary.md. No original theory answer or root premise is discharged.
